_doc: Firmament Ages - the fuel table: one FE value per bucket for every fluid a generator burns, whichever generator burns it
(harmony plan 2026-10-15, rule 3 and package A6). dev/gen_fuels.py writes the generator data from it: the IE Diesel
Generator fuels (burn time = FE per bucket / 4,096 FE/t), the Create: Diesel Generators fuel types (burn rate so that
engine + C&A Alternator gives the table value) and the Mekanism Gas-Burning Generator data map (energy per tick).
dev/gen_fuels.py --check compares the generated files with this table, every generator route within 'tolerance',
and the ladder: each fuel of 'ladder' holds more FE per bucket than the one before it.
Values are the mods' own defaults except where a second route paid more for the same fluid (CDG engines, 2026-10-16).

ie_diesel_generator._doc: IE dieselGen_output (default, not changed by the pack); a bucket lasts burnTime ticks

cdg_alternator._doc: FE per SU = fe_at_max_rpm x generator_efficiency / max_stress (480 x 0.35 / 16,384); every Diesel Generators engine is fuelled (H1A)

cdg_turbocharger._doc: the turbocharger multiplies speed and stress capacity; its burn rate multiplier equals the speed multiplier, so FE per bucket stays

mek_gas_burning._doc: Mekanism feConversionRate; energy (J per tick) x burn_time (ticks per mB) = J per mB

deuterium_tritium._doc: Mekanism fusion: fuelEnergy 10,000,000 J of heat per mB (generators.toml default), of which the passive thermocouples turn 5 % into power: 200 M FE per bucket before water heating. A ladder bound only; the fusion reactor reads its own config.

dead._doc: Fluids some generator would burn but nothing in the pack makes (refinery, CDG distillation and C&A fluids are removed): no table value, the generator data stays as the mod ships it or empty.
